content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the vilnius city district court the case involved a divorce and the division of property between the parties the court awarded the applicant a land plot with three outbuildings and a volvo v70 vehicle while the defendant was awarded a mercedesbenz e 320 cdi vehicle the court allowed the full action of the applicant and found grounds for dividing the parties property as proposed by the applicant the court also declared a joint debt owed by both spouses the applicant requested the dissolution of the marriage determination of child custody and financial matters and maintenance for the children the applicant claimed that the marriage had broken down due to the defendants neglect and substance abuse the court considered the defendant to have been duly informed of the proceedings but chose not to participate the court issued a judgment which included the division of property and the dissolution of the marriage
